mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19 and may increase cenobamate levels; cenobamate induces multiple CYP450 enzymes including CYP3A4 which can reduce omeprazole effectiveness.
action: Monitor for cenobamate toxicity signs; consider alternative PPI (pantoprazole) or monitor omeprazole efficacy and adjust cenobamate dose if needed based on clinical response.
